name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A dark-first developer blog in blue-charcoal and amber whose signature is the code — terminal-window frames with an amber top edge, a language tab and a copy button, set wider than the text — beside a changelog-style archive of dated posts.

tokens.--font-mono: the terminal voice — masthead, nav, meta lines, dates, tags, code
tokens.--font-sans: body prose and headings (humanist, comfortable for essays)
tokens.--text-xs: the smallest labels — language tab, copy button, table heads, tags in the archive
tokens.--text-s: meta lines, nav, archive dates, footer, code
tokens.--text-l: the lede under a title, archive entry titles and small headings (h3)
tokens.--text-xl: section headings (h2) inside posts and pages
tokens.--tracking-label: letter-spacing of uppercase labels (table heads, the contents title)
tokens.--color-bg: page background — warm paper by day, deep blue-charcoal (not black) in the dark scheme
tokens.--color-surface: raised panels: inline code, key caps, the contents box, the skip link
tokens.--color-muted: dates, meta lines, tags, list bullets, the footer, secondary text
tokens.--color-accent: amber — links, the prompt before the site name, the current nav item, focus rings, selected text
tokens.--color-accent-soft: a link while the pointer is over it
tokens.--color-accent-wash: the faint amber tint behind highlighted text and the heading you jumped to
tokens.--color-border: hairline rules: under the masthead, above the footer, table lines, the archive rail
tokens.--color-code-bg: code block background (stays dark in both schemes)
tokens.--color-code-muted: the copy button, the shell prompt sign and the code scrollbar
tokens.--color-code-bar: the title bar across the top of every code block
tokens.--color-code-border: the thin outline of the code frame
tokens.--color-code-edge: the amber top edge and language tab of every code frame, and the entry ticks on the archive rail
tokens.--measure: width of the page column — code blocks and tables use all of it
tokens.--measure-prose: maximum width of paragraphs, lists and headings — narrower than the column so code stands wider than the text
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column in the archive
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy (also the height of the code title bar)
tokens.--radius: corner rounding for code frames, images and panels
tokens.--radius-s: small corners — inline code, the copy button, the language tab, focus rings
tokens.--edge: thickness of accent strokes: focus outline, current nav underline, quote rule, archive ticks; the code frame's top edge is this plus one hairline
tokens.--rule: thickness of hairline rules and frame outlines
